visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a young man in a black T-shirt featuring a robotic bear graphic. He sits in front of a stone wall with intricate traditional carvings of clouds and mythical motifs. He has short black hair and a youthful face, looking slightly upward and gesturing naturally as he talks to an unseen interviewer. A microphone with yellow "哈哈台" branding is held in the lower right. (2) The scene shifts to include the interviewer, a young man wearing a black T-shirt, a silver necklace, and holding a clipboard. They are standing in a temple-like setting with ornate gold and stone architecture in the background. The two interact closely, with the interviewee demonstrating a judo grip on the interviewer, who appears slightly tense but smiling. (3) A dynamic action phase occurs where the interviewee performs a judo throw, lifting the interviewer onto his back and then dropping him onto the ground. The camera captures the movement from a medium shot, showing the physical coordination and the impact. The background remains the grey stone wall with vertical yellow inscriptions on the pillars. (4) The interviewer speaks directly to the camera in a medium close-up, his facial expressions shifting from shock to excitement. He wears a black T-shirt with white text. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting his features against the blurred temple background. (5) A stylized replay of the judo throw is shown with a romantic filter, including soft pink flower petal overlays and a dreamy blur. The two men are seen in a close embrace during the throw's transition. (6) The video returns to the original interview setup. The man in the bear T-shirt is sitting again, laughing and engaging in a lighthearted conversation. The camera remains static at eye level.
